name: Valtiendas

climate: Tempranillo sits in its sweet spot, so the wines can show the style it is known for.

terms: Vino de Calidad con Indicación Geográfica, a Spanish tier above Vino de la Tierra and below DO.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: A Vino de Calidad of 16 communes in northern Segovia province, whose rules allow wine from red Tempranillo, Garnacha Tinta, Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot and Syrah, with Albillo Mayor the one white grape.
